title: Test, publish and monitor
learningGoal: Make the process reliable before a real prospect sees it.

items.title: Submit the Form
items.description: Submit the selected form using a test email address.

items.title: Confirm Contact Record
items.description: Check that the expected contact record appears in Contacts.

items.title: Check Workflow Enrollment
items.description: Verify the workflow enrollment and the email in Conversations and/or workflow execution history.

items.title: Verify Email Delivery
items.description: Check that the email is delivered and the booking link opens the intended calendar.

items.title: No-Response Scenario
items.description: The single reminder is sent after the configured wait.

items.title: Reply Scenario
items.description: Subsequent sales reminder is suppressed when the contact replies.

items.title: Booking Scenario
items.description: Subsequent sales reminder is suppressed when the contact books.

items.title: Opt-outs Respected
items.description: Confirm opt-outs and workflow settings are respected.

items.title: Publish After Testing
items.description: Publish and save only after all testing is successful.

items.title: Exercise for Service Businesses
items.description: Write down who in your team should get a notification when an enquiry is submitted or a call is booked.

keyPoint: Test three scenarios before publishing: no response (reminder sends), reply (reminder suppressed), and booking (reminder suppressed). Only publish after successful end-to-end testing.

actionSteps.title: Submit a test form
actionSteps.description: Use a test email address to submit your enquiry form and confirm the contact record appears.

actionSteps.title: Test the no-response path
actionSteps.description: Wait for the configured time and confirm the reminder email sends correctly.

actionSteps.title: Test reply and booking paths
actionSteps.description: Verify that replying or booking suppresses the reminder email.

quizzes.question: When should you publish the workflow?

options.option_text: When the first real enquiry comes in

quizzes.explanation: Publish and save only after all testing is successful. Publishing before testing risks sending incorrect or incomplete follow-ups to real prospects.

quizzes.question: What should you test besides the email wording?

options.option_text: Form filter, delivery, merge fields, link, timing, booking and reply exits, opt-outs

quizzes.explanation: Test the form filter, email delivery, merge fields, booking link, wait timing, booking and reply exit paths, and opt-out handling. The email wording is only one part of a reliable follow-up journey.

quizzes.question: How many test scenarios should you run before publishing?

options.option_text: Three: no response, reply, and booked appointment
Five: one for each step of the formula
Two: form submission and email delivery

quizzes.explanation: Run three tests: no response (reminder sends), reply (reminder suppressed), and booked appointment (reminder suppressed). This ensures all paths work correctly before going live.
